title: Event page: winter skills weekend
content:
Event: Winter Skills Weekend, Saturday 6 to Sunday 7 December 2026, at Hollow Pine Camp, 88 Ridge Road, Mount Alder.

Description: Two days of hands-on practice for winter travel: avalanche awareness, snowshoe technique, and building a snow shelter. For adults with basic hiking experience.

Schedule:
Saturday 6 December
- 9:00 Arrival and gear check
- 10:00 Avalanche awareness
- 14:00 Snowshoe technique
Sunday 7 December
- 9:00 Snow shelters
- 13:00 Debrief and lunch

Price: $180 for members, $220 for others. Includes meals and a bunk.
Registration: a form with name, email, membership number (optional), and dietary needs; a Register button.
Spaces left: 6 of 24.
